mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies and 74 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park. The air quality index is 64, which is in the moderate range.

The city is moving forward with development projects at 201 South Main Street and plans for the Liberty Business Park. Also, the community recently participated in voting for the new student-designed I Voted stickers for the upcoming election.

There is a lot happening around town! You can enjoy trivia today at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and more.

Looking at the police report from this week, on August 8, officers assisted the Dane County Sheriff's office with a rollover crash where the driver had to be apprehended after fleeing the scene for an O W I offence.

Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. Since the store is currently closed, you can plan your visit for when they open at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
